strengths_deep_dive: Muslim Hands USA brings over three decades of institutional operational history to urgent humanitarian efforts. It maintains <cite id="2">explicit Zakat compliance guidelines</cite> to ensure funds reach eligible beneficiaries. Furthermore, the organization exhibits strong short-term financial stability, backed by <cite id="1">15.2 months of working capital</cite>.
rich_narrative.summary: Muslim Hands USA provides emergency relief and safe water to communities in need around the world. Founded in 1993, the organization addresses urgent humanitarian crises across regions including Gaza, Yemen, and Pakistan. In FY2024, the organization managed <cite id="3">Total Revenue of $2,027,541</cite> to support disaster relief and human development. While experiencing early-stage growth from its FY2022 revenue base of $297,478, its operational spending structure reflects substantial administrative overhead. In FY2024, the charity directed a <cite id="1">Program expense ratio of 43.7%</cite> toward direct program delivery. Despite these financial efficiency challenges, Muslim Hands USA maintains strong organizational longevity and holds a <cite id="1">71/100 rating from Charity Navigator</cite>.
